# Agent Client Collector Framework 4.3.1 - no agent package

ServiceNow released the Framework app 4.3.1 on the Store, but the download server holds no agent package numbered 4.3.1. A Framework release installs whichever agent build its property sn_agent.agent_version names, and that number can differ from the app's own; agent changes in these notes reached hosts through a neighbouring agent build. See the [index](README.md) for the agent versions around it.

## Change log

Agent Client Collector Framework 4.3.1: Minor release, published on the Store 2025-05-01, for the Zurich, Yokohama platform families.

**New**

- Proxy support for MID-less agents; mass upgrade of Linux and Windows agents; osquery 5.14.1; error framework improvements.

**Changed**

- Duplicate agent ID errors include the IP address; UI actions processed by MIDs run at interactive priority; deleting a MID-less agent deletes its registration record.

**Fixed**

- Reboot loop from an error at Windows service start-up; command prompts flashing during Windows install.
- Empty folders left in /tmp by osquery runs; -p parameter values shown as REDACTED in check commands.
- Windows install failing when the domain user came from another domain than the installing user.

Summarised from ServiceNow's release notes; the full text is on the [Store listing](https://store.servicenow.com/store/app/bc09636e1be06a50a85b16db234bcbd1) under Version details, Release notes.
